reasons: The shapes are simple and strict.
The abstract geometry count is not computed from anything visible here.
No tests are visible in the packet.

terms.meaning: The smallest box that contains every part of the model.
The total number of triangles the drawing uses, which affects how fast it renders.
Numbers that are real values, not infinite or missing.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and file header
sections.what: Gives the file its purpose and brings in the strict record base and the vector type used for positions.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the result shape built from the same vector type as the model.

sections.name: SceneBounds
sections.title: Bounds record
sections.what: Holds the minimum corner, maximum corner, centre, size and radius of the box around the model.
sections.why: Likely reason: the renderer needs these values to frame the camera.
sections.watch_out: The radius is a plain number and must match the size values for framing to look right.

sections.name: RenderManifest
sections.title: Render manifest record
sections.what: Holds the component counts, the triangle budget, the bounds, the finite-coordinates flag and the abstract geometry count.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the renderer one summary of what it is about to draw.
sections.watch_out: The abstract geometry count is always zero from the current service, so do not rely on it to flag real issues.

summary: Defines the shapes of the result returned by the render check: the overall box around the model and a summary of its counts and checks.
purpose: Gives the renderer a fixed, strict format for the check result, so it can trust the numbers it receives.
why: Likely reason: the renderer needs the box and counts in a known form before it draws anything.
how: A bounds record holds the minimum and maximum corners, the centre, the size and a radius. A manifest record holds the component counts, the triangle budget, the bounds, whether all coordinates are finite and a count of abstract geometry.
inputs: Values computed by the render check function in the service file.
outputs: A checked result record that the renderer and any callers can read.
risks: The manifest has no default values, so every field must be supplied. The abstract geometry count is always zero in the current code, and the code does not say what that count is meant to measure.
debug: If the render check fails with a validation error, compare the supplied values with the field names listed in this file.
